title: Backup summary
description: The summary.json in the root folder of a backup, as written by backup:create.

backupCreated.description: Time of the backup, formatted as `Y-m-d H:i:s e`, e.g. `2026-11-22 18:14:03 UTC`.

nodeCount.description: Number of node files in the backup.

relationCount.description: Number of relation files in the backup.

fileCount.description: Number of files, i.e. contents of file elements, in the backup.

graphStructure.description: All node labels and relation types of the database. Missing in backups of older versions.

hostname.description: Hostname of the machine which created the backup.

version.description: Version of the API which created the backup, `dev` for development builds. Backups of versions before 0.2.0 have to be converted by backup:convert.

convertedFromVersion.description: Only set by backup:convert: the version of the original backup. `version` is set to 0.2.0 by the conversion.

backupVersion.description: Only set by the release workflow of the reference dataset: version of the dataset.
